classificationContract.candidatePublic: Class is defined in source CSS but not used in raw docs.
classificationContract.deprecated: Manual override for selectors planned for removal or replacement.
classificationContract.docsOnly: Class is used in raw docs but not defined in source CSS.
classificationContract.internal: Manual override for implementation detail selectors.
classificationContract.legacyCompatible: Manual override for selectors preserved for compatibility.
classificationContract.public: Class is defined in source CSS and used in raw docs.

compatibilityRule: public, candidate-public, and legacy-compatible selectors must not be removed or renamed without an approved migration/deprecation plan.
